evals.name: Corporate Event Launch
evals.prompt: Plan a 500-person tech conference in San Francisco for next November. Budget is $200k.
expectations: Includes a RACI Matrix for key stakeholders
Identifies the Critical Path (e.g., Venue Booking -> Speaker Lock)
Breaks down budget into categories (Venue, Catering, AV, Marketing)

evals.name: Marketing Campaign
evals.prompt: Launch a Q4 Black Friday marketing campaign for an e-commerce shoe brand.
expectations: Defines specific KPIs (ROAS, CPA, Conversion Rate)
Timeline includes 'Creative Asset Production' lead time
Identifies 'Inventory Stockout' as a major risk
